reason: Strategy is post-announcement takeover arbitrage with discretionary human intervention on credibility, downside and position sizing; requires event data and is not reducible to daily-bar rules.

universe.description: Australian stocks under formal takeover offers

setup.rule: Wait for formal unconditional takeover announcement
setup.quote: our strategy actually is that we wait until the takeover has been announced and it's formal and then we buy the shares

entry.rule: Buy after announcement once downside is known and limited
entry.quote: make sure that we think it's a credible target a credible bidder that the downside you know is known and limited and then you know position accordingly

stop.rule: Hard stop at the guaranteed takeover price
stop.quote: you're going to be able to sell that stock at $1.71 so that's really your hard stop loss

exits.rule: Exit early if risk-reward no longer favorable or on improved/ competing bids
exits.quote: if the share price improves in the interim you know we may look to exit the position early if we think that the risk reward is no longer in our favor

sizing.rule: Risk fixed amount per trade; scale up when reward/risk multiple is high
sizing.quote: we're happy to risk X amount per trade you know for a stock standard what I'll call opportunity and that you know really dictates our position size

market_filter.rule: Low market beta once under takeover
market_filter.quote: takeovers have generally pretty low correlation to the market

ambiguities.issue: Transcript describes Australian ASX stocks and takeover rules that no longer exist
ambiguities.assumption: Core logic of post-announcement risk-defined arbitrage is the method discussed
